title: Use source-aware ToneTrace export defaults
problem: The GUI export dialog starts at analysis.mid in the process working directory.
reproduce: Open analyzed audio and choose Export; the baseline dialog uses analysis.mid instead of the source folder and name.
acceptance: The first export defaults beside the source as <stem>.tonetrace.mid, and a successful export persists the selected directory.
repair: Build the dialog path from the source audio and store the successful output directory in the existing QSettings.

verification.limitations: BCL verifies patch application, Python syntax and source contracts. Two offscreen GUI tests and the 508-test available upstream suite passed separately.
verification.ownerCheck: Open the export dialog for two audio files, save the first to another folder, and confirm the second uses that folder with its own .tonetrace.mid name.
